openehr_id.name: openehr_id
openehr_id.description:
Identifier used for code set in the openEHR Reference Model. The value is inferred from the `_name_` attribute.

Valid values take the form of an xs:NCName value, i.e. cannot contain:

* symbol characters `:, @, $, %, &, /, +, ,, ;`;
* whitespace characters or different parentheses. 

An NCName cannot begin with a number, dot or minus character although these can appear later in the value.

external_id.name: external_id
external_id.description:
An optional identifier assumed by openEHR to be the identifier of this code set, based on its published name, with spaces replaced by underscores.

Valid values take the form of an xs:NCName value, i.e. cannot contain:

* symbol characters `:, @, $, %, &, /, +, ,, ;`;
* whitespace characters or different parentheses. 

An NCName cannot begin with a number, dot or minus character although these can appear later in the value.

TERMINOLOGY_GROUP.description: A single vocabulary, in a particular language, within a Terminology.

concepts.name: concepts

CODE.name: CODE
CODE.description: A single code entity in a code set.

value.name: value
value.description: The code string for this code entity, e.g. `"AF"`.

description.name: description
description.description:
Optional description of this code, e.g. `"AFGHANISTAN"`.

This field may be used to hold translations of the description in a language-specific copy of the English language original code set.

status.name: status
status.description: Status of this code within the code set.

TERMINOLOGY_CONCEPT.name: TERMINOLOGY_CONCEPT
TERMINOLOGY_CONCEPT.description: A single terminology concept in a vocabulary.

rubric.name: rubric
rubric.description: The rubric, i.e. linguistic expression, of this concept, in the language of this terminology instance.

status.name: status
status.description: Status of this concept within the vocabulary.

TERMINOLOGY.name: TERMINOLOGY
TERMINOLOGY.description: Container for code sets and/or vocabularies that belong to a given logical terminology.

language.name: language
language.description: Language of this terminology, as an ISO:639 2-letter code.

vocabularies.name: vocabularies
vocabularies.description: Vocabularies of coded terms in this terminology.

version.name: version
version.description: Version of this instance of the terminology.

date.name: date
date.description: Date of issue of this version of the terminology.

TERMINOLOGY_STATUS.name: TERMINOLOGY_STATUS
TERMINOLOGY_STATUS.description: Enumeration of possible lifecycle states of any part of the terminomlogy.

enumerations.name: trial
enumerations.description: Terminology element is in Trial state.

enumerations.name: active
enumerations.description: Terminology element is in Active state, i.e. published and in use.

enumerations.name: retired
enumerations.description: Terminology element has been Retired, i.e. deprecated.
